fixes.explanation: That's him. Jehu says the LORD "…has done what He promised through His servant Elijah." (2 Kings 10:10) Elijah was the prophet the LORD sent with a word for Ahab (1 Kings 21:17). The passage ends by pointing back to him too, with "…the word that the LORD had spoken to Elijah." (2 Kings 10:17)

ZEAL, baker! That's the word Jehu picks. He's helping Jehonadab into the chariot when he says, "Come with me and see my zeal for the LORD!" (2 Kings 10:16) I think that's a big thing to promise a man while you're still pulling him aboard.
